title: Dragon Pixel — Xenoverse 2 3D scene
description: Animated characters, models, sounds and texts loaded on demand from the CPK archives, rendered with WebAssembly and WebGPU. The game’s combat is not connected yet.
audioHint: AWB banks contain the waveforms. An ACB plays here only when its waveforms are embedded; otherwise choose its companion AWB file. The track number is the index within the bank.
error: This resource could not be loaded. Retry or select another entry.
empty: No matching entries in this archive.
modelHint: Choose an EMD file. Its geometry is rendered in 3D, with textures when included in the conversion.
unavailable: The CPK service is temporarily unavailable.
gpu: WebGPU and the GLB engine are required to display this model.
characterHint: Code of a game character (data/chara folder), for example APL, GOK or FRI. Skeleton, animations, models, textures and materials are read from data.cpk and animated in WebAssembly.
characterMissing: This character has no skeleton, animations or full model in data.cpk.
